title: Preparing the Shamba — 5 min Lesson (Sample)
body: Video script sample — use Studio to generate a full 5-minute script with hook, lesson, quiz, and outro.

scriptSections.label: Hook
scriptSections.content: Habari Grade 4! Have you ever helped prepare soil for planting?
scriptSections.visualCue: Kenyan child on a small farm

scriptSections.label: Lesson
scriptSections.content: Step 1: Clear weeds. Step 2: Loosen soil. Step 3: Add manure.

scriptSections.label: Quiz
scriptSections.content: True or False: We should plant before clearing weeds?

scriptSections.label: Outro
scriptSections.content: Download the worksheet and practice at home. Kwaheri!
